other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Study centered on coal-fired thermal power plants and steam shops (continuous power/heat generation) switching fuels to coal-water slurries
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
we show the possibility of coal-ﬁred thermal power plants and steam shops
switching to coal-water slurries containing petrochemicals (CWSP)

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Description of a TPP fuel system as a continuous line to receive, store, prepare and transport fuel within the power plant
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
A TPP fuel system is a line of installations to receive, store,
prepare, and transport fuel within the power plant.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Mention of CWS use in steam generators, industrial furnaces and kilns
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
CWS is widely used in steam generators
of more than 20 thermal power plants, in over 300 industrial furnaces
and hundreds of kilns

one_line: Techno-economic and environmental analysis of coal-fired thermal power plants and steam shops switching from traditional fuels (coal, fuel oil, gas) to coal-water slurries containing petrochemical wastes — a power-generation context, not one of the eight registered Corpus B sectors.
